entries.text: However you did it, however you knew what you know, what matters here is you saved a woman's life.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: He's trying. We all are. It's just a long way to go from... This... To this.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Do you believe in second chances, Dana? A chance to correct the mistakes we make in our lives?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: You mean in a future life?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: That's what these people were trying to do. All the victims, trying to atone for their sins... From what happened in that photo. Only this man wouldn't let them.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: And lisa holland? What about her?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: She was one of them. One of the men you see standing there.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: And you?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Whoever I was, I failed. In 1868. In 1909. In 1960, I failed. I was always there, but I couldn't stop the killings, and he knew that. Just like he knows I'm here right now. He feels me-- the way I felt him... When I saw that picture of the first victim. And somehow he knows my deepest fear-- that I'll fail.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Well, maybe in this life you succeed.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Maybe.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes
